summary: V3 feature testing (Semantic Search, Voice Capture/Whisper, Weekly Reflection, Interview Countdown) plus full regression. Backend pytest: 28/30 passed, 1 skipped (reportlab-based test now runs and passes, so only the flaky candidate-extraction cases skip-fail — same LLM non-determinism documented in iteration_2). All 7 new V3 tests PASS: (1) POST /knowledge/search returns ranked results with 'reason' strings — top hit for 'how do I structure a product design interview answer' is CIRCLES method (semantic hit with no keyword overlap); nonsense query returns few/no results. (2) POST /conversation/transcribe returns 422 on missing file and returns non-empty text for a real gTTS-generated mp3 audio clip via Whisper. (3) GET /reflection/weekly returns warm reflection + stats {attended_this_week, coming_up, prep_done, ...}; 2nd call cached=true; ?refresh=true regenerates cached=false. (4) POST /dream/countdown/generate builds a full plan (company/role/target_date/days_remaining/days[focus,tasks]/progress); PATCH toggles task done and recomputes progress; company_id targets Adobe correctly. Frontend Playwright: Knowledge mode toggle works (Contains list ↔ By meaning results with italic 'Why · ...' reason); Talk mic button renders and changes icon state on click; /reflection page (linked via more-reflection) shows reflection-text and reflection-stats columns, refresh regenerates text; Dream Offer countdown-section shows countdown-plan with 6 day cards + 6 tappable tasks, clicking a task toggles the done state (dot fills). Regression: existing Home, Talk stream, Memory, People, DreamOffer, Calendar, Knowledge upload all still healthy.

minor.issue: Flaky LLM-driven candidate extraction: when Kukdi decides the memory is 'Already in my notes' (e.g. running before exams — now genuinely present in DB from prior test runs), 0 candidates are returned. Assertion 'candidates>=1' fails ~30% of runs. This is by-design behavior, not a code defect — reasoning.converse suppresses duplicates. Consider using a unique random title in each test run to bypass dedup.

critical_code_review_comments: routes/dream.py generate_countdown: happy-path only. If reasoning.interview_plan raises (LLM outage, JSON parse failure), the endpoint 500s with no fallback. Consider wrapping in try/except and returning a minimal seed plan (e.g. 3 days × 3 generic tasks) so the UI never sees a broken state.

routes/dream.py generate_countdown: when body.company_id is provided but the company is not found, the code silently falls through to defaults ('Google', 'Product Manager') instead of raising 404. Users passing a stale/invalid id will get a plan for the wrong company. Return 404 or at least reflect the invalid id in the response.

routes/reflection.py weekly: reflection_stats is written to db.settings under the singleton doc. Fine for now, but if you ever want to show week-over-week trends, store per-week rows in a dedicated collection.

routes/conversation.py transcribe: no file-size cap and no extension whitelist. A user could upload a 500 MB webm and block a worker while Whisper chokes. Add a 25 MB limit (Whisper's own limit) and validate extension in the audio set.

routes/knowledge.py semantic_search: loads up to 500 items from Mongo on every call and passes them to the LLM. At scale this is wasteful and expensive. Pre-filter with a simple lexical/BM25 hit list before semantic re-ranking, or add a vector index once corpus grows.
routes/knowledge.py semantic_search: no rate-limiting; each search costs a Claude call. For a single-user MVP acceptable, but flag for future.

success_rate.backend: 93% (28/30, 2 flaky LLM-dedup, 0 skips after installing reportlab+gTTS)

seed_data_creation: TEST_ prefixed data (memory, company, prep, knowledge, countdown replaces active plan). Countdown active plan is left behind — this is expected as it replaces on next generate. gTTS audio is in-memory only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: `REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=$(grep REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL /app/frontend/.env | cut -d= -f2) python -m pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v`. Deps required: `pip install gTTS reportlab` (installed by this iteration). gTTS test hits Google TTS + Whisper — both external and slow (~5s). Whisper transcribe returned non-empty text as expected. Semantic search LLM call is ~3-5s; frontend correctly waits. Countdown replaces the active plan on each generate — no need to clean up. Two long-standing flaky candidate tests are LLM dedup behavior, not bugs; main agent could either accept them as-is or add a random nonce to the test message to bypass dedup.
rca of the issue: No blocking bugs found in V3. The 2 legacy conversation-candidate assertions fail because after several test iterations the LLM correctly recognises the 'running before exams' insight is already in memory and returns 0 candidates (reply: 'Already in my notes'). Fix: parametrize test text with a unique nonce so dedup doesn't fire.
